title: Isandro and the Verdict Again
author: E. M. Joubert
blurb: Bram Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
